title: 'Sellers may submit false declarations': Why CCPA penalised Amazon, Flipkart, JioMart for selling unregistered herbicide
summary: India's CCPA fined Amazon, Flipkart, and JioMart for selling the unregistered 'Cyclosinone Herbicide'. The platforms were penalized for inadequate seller verification and must stop sales, conduct self-audits, and submit compliance reports within 15 days.
